liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: The interpolator of William of Malmesbury’s Gesta regum
liebermann.notes: A copyist of c. 1150–1200 who inserted from Quadripartitus Wl lad and the Praefatio to CHn cor after the history of William I in William of Malmesbury's Gesta Regum; copied in Cs, Ht, He and Pi.

entries.text_de: Interpolator Willelmi Malmesbiriensis, hinter dessen Geschichte Wilhelm's I. in Gesta Regum8 schaltet ein Abschreiber etwa 1150—1200 aus Quadr. ein: Wl lad, u. S. 483 und Praef. ad CHn cor, u. S. 542. Er wurde copirt in Cs Ht He und Pi.
entries.text_en: Interpolator of William of Malmesbury: after his history of William I in the Gesta Regum8 a copyist c. 1150—1200 inserts from Quadr.: Wl lad, below, p. 483, and Praef. ad CHn cor, below, p. 542. He was copied in Cs Ht He and Pi.

transcription.doubts: Heading printed 'Ip Ml' (with a space). The entry runs from the foot of column 1 to the top of column 2 on the same page. 'Pi' confirmed at 600 dpi.
